---
title: "Practice exercises: joins and tidying data"
---

The exercises below run in your browser and check your code automatically, giving you feedback as you go. They cover `left_join()` and `pivot_longer()`, and give you a chance to combine these with everything else you've learned in Data Analysis 1-3. The last two are a bit more of a challenge - don't worry if you need a few tries.

The data challenge exercise on the previous page isn't included here, since it's too open-ended for automatic checking - keep doing that one in Posit Cloud.
